profiles.notes: Rules name the qualification and entry route they cover. Local and non-local status follow the Hong Kong admissions definitions.

requirements.label: Year 1 · international qualifications
requirements.details: Applicants with overseas qualifications meet one listed academic route and the university English requirement. Programme choice, specific requirements, English and interview performance can affect selection. Equivalent qualifications can be reviewed individually.

requirements.label: AP route · two subject exams
requirements.details: Present AP grades of at least 3 in two subjects. This is one academic route for applicants presenting international qualifications.

requirements.label: GCE A-level route · eligible passes
requirements.details: Present at least two GCE A-level subjects at grade E or above. Chinese is excluded from the two qualifying subjects.

requirements.label: ACT route · composite score
requirements.details: For the ACT route, the published composite score is 24.

requirements.label: SAT route · total score
requirements.details: For the redesigned SAT taken from March 2016 onward, the published total is 1190. HSUHK may also assess the secondary school examination record.

requirements.label: Taiwan · Advanced Subjects Test
requirements.details: Meet the average standard (均標) in each of the best three eligible subjects: Mathematics A, Physics, Chemistry, Biology, History, Geography, and Citizenship and Society. English must also reach the good standard (前標).

requirements.label: Taiwan · General Scholastic Ability Test
requirements.details: Meet the average standard (均標) in each of the best three from Chinese, Mathematics A, Mathematics B, Society and Science, plus the good standard (前標) in English.

requirements.label: New Zealand NCEA · qualification and literacy credits
requirements.details: Complete NCEA Level 3. Earn at least 10 credits graded Achieved or higher at Level 2 or above, including five reading credits and five writing credits.

requirements.label: Malaysia · SPM and STPM route
requirements.details: At SPM, achieve C or better in at least seven subjects with six in one sitting. At STPM, earn C or better in at least three non-language subjects in one sitting. English must reach C at SPM or STPM.

requirements.label: Malaysia · Unified Examination Certificate
requirements.details: Earn at least C in seven UEC subjects, with at least six in the same sitting. UEC English requires B4 or above.

requirements.label: English · IELTS Academic
requirements.details: For the IELTS route, take the Academic test at a test centre and obtain an overall 5.5 or higher in one sitting. HSUHK excludes One Skill Retake.

requirements.label: English · TOEFL iBT by test date
requirements.details: For a test before 21 January 2026, obtain at least 70/120. From that date, obtain at least 4/6. Use one sitting at a test centre; the university excludes MyBest combinations.

requirements.label: Actuarial Studies · legacy SAT Mathematics Subject Test
requirements.details: The SAT route still lists 650 in the SAT Mathematics Subject Test for Actuarial Studies and Insurance. College Board discontinued Subject Tests in 2021. Applicants using the current SAT should confirm acceptable mathematics evidence with HSUHK. The university names the historical subject exam specifically.

requirements.label: Programme preferences and conditional offers
requirements.details: Submit one online application and rank as many programme choices as desired. All choices are processed. A suitable applicant receives one offer according to preference order. Candidates may apply with pending examination results and must supply final evidence by their offer deadline.

requirements.label: Documents for applicants with international qualifications
requirements.details: Upload a recent photograph, high school reports, the international examination result slip and certificates for other academic qualifications. Update the record when new results arrive.

requirements.label: International qualification route · assessments
requirements.details: If invited, an applicant must attend and pass the required written test or interview. Format varies by degree and may involve an individual or group interview. Check email and the application system for arrangements.

requirements.label: HKDSE · core language grades
requirements.details: For first-year HKDSE entry, Chinese Language and English Language each require level 3. Approved Chinese-language alternatives are available to eligible non-Chinese-speaking applicants.

requirements.label: HKDSE · compulsory Mathematics
requirements.details: The general HKDSE route requires level 2 in the compulsory part of Mathematics.

requirements.label: Actuarial Studies · compulsory HKDSE Mathematics
requirements.details: The actuarial programme raises the compulsory Mathematics requirement to HKDSE level 3.

requirements.label: HKDSE · citizenship or prior Liberal Studies
requirements.details: For the HKDSE from 2024, Citizenship and Social Development requires Attained and contributes zero ranking points. Level 2 or above in Liberal Studies from 2023 or earlier meets this requirement.

requirements.label: HKDSE · elective qualification by exam year
requirements.details: For exams through 2023, present a Category A elective at level 2 or above. For exams from 2024, present a Category A elective at level 2, Category B Applied Learning at Attained, or a Category C language at the HKEAA-approved proficiency. Extended Mathematics M1/M2 cannot fulfil this entrance elective. It may be used separately in selected programme ranking formulas.

requirements.label: HKDSE · alternative Chinese-language evidence
requirements.details: The non-Chinese-speaking route covers students who learned Chinese for fewer than six years in primary and secondary school, or studied a simpler adapted Chinese curriculum for six years or more. Accepted alternatives include HKDSE Applied Learning Chinese at Attained, GCSE or IGCSE Chinese at grade C or 4, or GCE A-level Chinese at E.

requirements.label: HKDSE NMTSS · discretionary interview
requirements.details: The Year 1 assessment table lists an interview on a case-by-case basis. Invitations are sent through the admission system or by email.

requirements.label: HKDSE NMTSS · programme interview
requirements.details: The first-year HKDSE assessment table specifies an interview for this programme.

requirements.label: HKDSE English degree · test and interview
requirements.details: The English programme lists both a written test and an interview for shortlisted first-year HKDSE candidates.

requirements.label: HKDSE translation degree · selection assessments
requirements.details: The first-year assessment table lists both the written test and the interview on a case-by-case basis.

requirements.label: Local September application window
requirements.details: For September 2027, the local application period for NMTSS and SSSDP degrees runs from 21 November 2026 through 18 August 2027. Programmes may close early if places fill.

requirements.label: Local supporting evidence
requirements.details: Submit a Hong Kong identity card. The local application checklist asks for proof of English proficiency if available.

requirements.label: Application fee and offer deposit
requirements.details: The application fee is HKD 100 per programme. Late payment is treated as withdrawal. Pay the HKD 5,000 enrolment deposit by the offer deadline to accept. The deposit counts toward tuition and fees are non-refundable and non-transferable.

requirements.label: JUPAS · HKDSE selection formula
requirements.details: Actuarial Studies ranks five weighted subjects including English and compulsory Mathematics, from core subjects, Category A electives and extended Mathematics M1/M2. In a tie the programme can consider band choice, interview, other achievements and the school nomination.

requirements.label: JUPAS · HKDSE subject weights
requirements.details: Weight 5 applies to English Language, Mathematics (Compulsory Part), Business, Accounting and Financial Studies, Economics, Extended Mathematics M1/M2, Physics. Weight 3 applies to Chinese Language, Biology, Chemistry, Information and Communication Technology, Science: Combined Science, Science: Integrated Science. Weight 2 applies to Others (Other Category A subjects only). Weight 0 applies to Citizenship and Social Development.

requirements.label: JUPAS · HKDSE selection formula
requirements.details: Applied Computing adds its five highest weighted HKDSE subject scores. Interview performance is also important for selection.

requirements.label: JUPAS · HKDSE subject weights
requirements.details: Weight 3 applies to Mathematics (Compulsory Part), Business, Accounting and Financial Studies, Economics, Information and Communication Technology, Extended Mathematics M1/M2, Physics. Weight 2 applies to Chinese Language, English Language, Biology, Chemistry, Science: Combined Science, Science: Integrated Science. Weight 1 applies to Others. Weight 0 applies to Citizenship and Social Development.

requirements.label: JUPAS · HKDSE selection formula
requirements.details: Data Science and Business Intelligence uses the best five subjects including compulsory Mathematics. Core, Category A electives and Mathematics M1/M2 are eligible. Citizenship and Social Development contributes zero. Band choice, interview performance and other achievements or school nominations can break ties.

requirements.label: JUPAS · HKDSE selection formula
requirements.details: Business Analytics and Information Management adds the best five weighted subject results with English and Mathematics included. Band choice and interview can break ties.

requirements.label: JUPAS · HKDSE subject weights
requirements.details: Weight 10 applies to English Language, Mathematics (Compulsory Part), Business, Accounting and Financial Studies, Economics, Geography, Information and Communication Technology, Extended Mathematics M1/M2, Physics. Weight 7 applies to Chinese Language, Biology, Chemistry, Design and Applied Technology. Weight 5 applies to Others. Weight 0 applies to Citizenship and Social Development.

requirements.label: JUPAS · HKDSE selection formula
requirements.details: Art and Design uses the sum of the best five HKDSE subject results and also considers interview performance. At most one Category B or C subject can count toward the five.

requirements.label: JUPAS · programme assessment
requirements.details: Selected applicants may be interviewed in June or July. Missing an arranged interview can lower priority.

requirements.label: JUPAS · programme assessment
requirements.details: A written test and interview may each be arranged individually.

requirements.label: JUPAS · programme assessment
requirements.details: Selected applicants interview in May through July. Applicants who miss their arranged appointment receive lower priority.

requirements.label: JUPAS · programme assessment
requirements.details: There is no written test. Selected applicants may interview in June or July.

requirements.label: JUPAS · programme assessment
requirements.details: Selected applicants may interview in June or July. Those missing an arranged interview receive lower priority.

requirements.label: JUPAS · programme assessment
requirements.details: Selected applicants may interview in June or July and should submit a portfolio of relevant art and design work. Missing an arranged interview can lower priority.

requirements.label: Non-local, non-JEE September application window
requirements.details: Non-local applicants outside the mainland JEE route can apply for September 2027 from 21 November 2026 through 27 June 2027.

requirements.label: Non-local September entry · qualification timing
requirements.details: The international qualifications guidance asks non-local applicants to complete their qualifying award before late July for consideration for September entry that year. The separate calendar lists A-level results in mid-August. Applicants relying on those results should confirm the offer conditions.

requirements.label: Non-local supporting evidence
requirements.details: Upload a travel document or proof of identity, such as a passport, plus English proficiency evidence. The university may later request originals for verification. Mainland Chinese applicants are asked for a mainland identity card and household evidence.

requirements.label: Application fee and offer deposit
requirements.details: The application fee is HKD 200 per programme. Late payment is treated as withdrawal. Pay the HKD 30,000 enrolment deposit by the offer deadline to accept. The deposit counts toward tuition and fees are non-refundable and non-transferable.

requirements.label: Mature entry · eligibility for self-financed degrees
requirements.details: Be at least 23 by September of the admission year. Show at least two years of work experience in the chosen field or the ability to pursue that field of study. Programme assessments still apply.

requirements.label: JUPAS · HKDSE selection formula
requirements.details: Supply Chain Management ranks five weighted HKDSE subjects including English and Mathematics. Ties may take account of JUPAS band choice and interview performance.

requirements.label: JUPAS · HKDSE subject weights
requirements.details: Weight 10 applies to English Language, Mathematics (Compulsory Part), Business, Accounting and Financial Studies, Economics, Geography, Information and Communication Technology, Extended Mathematics M1/M2, Physics. Weight 7 applies to Chinese Language, Biology, Chemistry. Weight 5 applies to Others. Weight 0 applies to Citizenship and Social Development.

requirements.label: 2026 JUPAS averages · HKDSE reporting scale
requirements.details: For the 2026 reference table, convert levels 5**, 5* and 5 to 7, 6 and 5 points; levels 4 to 1 carry their number and Unclassified carries zero. The published averages use the best five subjects, with extended Mathematics M1/M2 eligible. These historical averages are distinct from a degree’s weighted selection formula.

requirements.label: Year 3 entry · prior award and GPA
requirements.details: Complete a relevant associate degree or higher diploma at a recognised Hong Kong or overseas institution with cumulative GPA of at least 2.5 or equivalent. The department arranges an interview and may also require a written test.

requirements.label: Year 3 entry · maximum block credit
requirements.details: Graduates of associate degree and higher diploma programmes can receive block credit for up to half of the actuarial degree’s units. Transferred units count toward graduation and are excluded from cumulative GPA.
